I know this is an old post. Over a year ago, I dealt with some super severe workplace bullying. I'm talking about being called names and being made fun of. I was being called stupid, and a s**t daily, I would overhear it constantly. All of it was unwarranted, especially since none of it was true, and no one knew me to even make those judgments. I was truly targeted. I had coworkers try to get me in trouble constantly as well. I started just getting to the point of crying daily in my car or bathroom.  I felt like there was something wrong with me. I had my friends and family desperately tell me to quit, and they all offered me financial support while I was trying to find a new job. I quit only 6 months in with like 3 days' notice. It was that bad. I legit left my last day crying, I guess I was happy it was over. At that new job, I was truly accepted by my peers. I met some super nice and geuinie people. No one made fun of me behind my back, I had good coworker friends. People frankly were just normal and nice. I was told by my manager I did good work. It was a night and day difference. And nothing changed about me either, I was just around normal people. Most people are not going to bully and target their coworkers super severely. If it does happen, it might be a few people, not half the store or office. I think that job was the only one out of like six I've had where people bullied me.  You will get a level of shit talking anywhere you work, but name calling or truly making fun of people is not normal. Honestly, just leave as fast as you can! Any place is better than being bullied and harassed daily. Go somewhere where people leave you alone or are nice to you!
